• Served as Banking Subject Matter Expert for Retail Banking, Corporate Banking, Wholesale Banking, Core Banking, Payments, Lending, Mortgage, Risk, Treasury, and Digital Banking transformation projects.

• Reviewed SQL data validation reports, reconciliation reports, and production metrics.
• Assisted Product Owners with backlog prioritization, business value assessment, and release planning.
• Conducted knowledge transfer sessions and mentored Business Analysts on banking domain concepts and regulatory compliance.

source_lines: Business Analyst at HDFC Bank Ltd. (Sep 2012 – Oct 2017)

• Supported API integration testing using REST APIs, JSON, XML, Swagger, and Postman.

• Worked on Retail Banking, Core Banking, Digital Banking, Payments, Lending, Mortgage, KYC/AML, and Customer Onboarding initiatives.
• Supported production deployment, Hypercare activities, incident management, and release management.
